turns.content: Name the three constitutional isomers of dimethylbenzene and note the methyl-group equivalence in each.
For the meta isomer, state the symmetry relation of the substituted sites and identify the distinct aromatic proton classes and their ortho neighbours.
Using that compound class and those signal types, derive the simplified first-order integrations and multiplicities for its three constitutional topologies.

A report lists the downfield pattern 7.2 ppm (2H,t), 6.9 ppm (1H,d), and 6.8 ppm (1H,s). Identify the intended topology within the compound class under discussion and the integration-coupling contradiction.
State the first-order pattern implied by that topology and justify it using the relation and splitting rule established above.
Give the final judgment on the reported pattern and the spectral features that support it.
